verdict.rationale: Stripe's own docs say Radar evaluates transactions in real time using AI algorithms to assess fraud risk, which covers the ML-screening half of the story. Nothing in the evidence documents custom block, review, or allow rules, fraud-score visibility, or a finance-ops rule-authoring workflow. missing for 10: documented custom block/review/allow rule authoring, exposed per-transaction risk scores, manual review queue, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can screen transactions with machine-learning fraud scores and write custom block, review, and allow rules

citations.quote: Use Radar to evaluate transactions, accounts, and customers in real time, using AI algorithms to assess the risk of fraud.
